hooks.name: Block Hardcoded API Keys
hooks.description: Prevents accidental hardcoding of Nebius or Tavily API keys in source code

action.prompt: Before writing code, verify that no API keys, tokens, or secrets are hardcoded. All secrets must come from environment variables (os.getenv or process.env). If the write contains a hardcoded key pattern (sk-, tvly-, or any long alphanumeric string that looks like a credential), block it and suggest using an environment variable instead.
